meta.name: Generative Edit (FLUX 3 Image Klein, Mac)
meta.licenseNote: FLUX 3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs) under its own flux-3-image-klein license; the MLX files are mflux-community's conversion (same licence). Bring your own files; Get AI Models offers them on a Mac.
meta.notes: Runs natively on a Mac (genai-native gn-diffusion flux3-klein/edit on gn-mlx, MLX): Klein's distilled 16-step flow map, the picture as its reference at about 768² (the output takes its aspect), LoRAs unmerged. With AusBoss's FLUX-3-Image-Klein-Outpaint-LoRA (loras/flux-3-image-klein-outpaint.safetensors) generate.expand sends the grey (#808080) padded canvas here with the LoRA at 1.5 and its instruction prompt. q4 on a 16 GB M1 Air at 512²: about 190 s.
meta.creator: Black Forest Labs · mflux-community
meta.description: Edits by instruction on the Mac's GPU: cleaner than MOSS Edit, slower
